name: Gypsy Encampment
desc1: The contrast between the dark Blackwood Forest and the gypsy camp are
desc2: as night and day.  Colorful wagons surround a large fire in the middle
desc3: with cookpots almost set to boil. You sense you are being watched yet
desc4: the gypsys don't seem to even recognize your existance. You take
desc5: caustious steps from here, for angering the gypsyies has ended many
